title: Process-aware web programming with Jolie
review_status: full-text audit complete; static/dynamic benchmark comparisons, service-count scalability test, and single-machine scope checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v3; 2014 version header inspected; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Representative tests on one i5-2500K/8GB host find roughly comparable page-serving performance with Apache/GlassFish and gracefully degrading throughput for 20–80 parallel news services; not a production-scale comparison.

title: SMT Solving for Functional Programming over Infinite Structures
review_status: full-text audit complete; N-lambda design, SMT integration, two examples, and transfer limits checked
sections_checked: infinite graph coloring example and discussion
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2016-04-05; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Haskell-embedded language for first-order-definable infinite structures; two examples show finite-code reuse in one case but domain-specific mathematics in another. Proof of concept, not broad performance/usability evaluation.

title: The MISRA C Coding Standard and its Role in the Development and Analysis of Safety- and Security-Critical Embedded Software
review_status: full-text audit complete; standard overview distinguished from outcome evaluation; decidability and analyzer unknown/false-positive tradeoffs checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2018-09-04; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Technical overview/position paper, not controlled defect-reduction study. For undecidable rules, checker approximations trade false positives against false negatives; compliance sits in a documented deviation process.

title: CoNST: Code Generator for Sparse Tensor Networks
review_status: full-text audit complete; constraint-based loop/layout generation, benchmark speedups, memory failures, and workload scope checked
sections_checked: FROSTT decomposition experiments and memory limits
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-01-09; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Selected sparse tensor workloads show large gains, including about 100x in one integral case; some larger cases exceed target-platform memory for CoNST or baselines. Not a general compiler speedup estimate.

title: The Cost of Executing Business Processes on Next-Generation Blockchains: The Case of Algorand
review_status: full-text audit complete; cost model, BPMN-to-TEAL implementation, two local workloads, account-balance contribution, and static-congestion limitation checked
sections_checked: local sandbox setup and two process benchmarks
exchange rates, minimum-balance accounting, and limitations
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-07-09; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: On two local workflow examples, minimum-balance costs can reach 85% of total; headline blockchain-vs-cloud comparison depends on balance accounting and historical exchange rates. Authors say runs are static local experiments, not congestion simulation.

title: Oracular Programming: A Modular Foundation for Building LLM-Enabled Software
review_status: full-text audit complete; framework and Code2Inv matched-budget results, three-seed protocol, comparison, and overhead limitations checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v5; version header inspected; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: On 124 Code2Inv problems at 20 cents/problem, abduction-based GPT-4o-mini solves 124 at 0.12 cents average; ReAct baselines solve 113–124 at higher cost. Three random seeds, one invariant-synthesis task; abstraction has adoption/physical overhead.

title: CoQuIR: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Code Quality-Aware Information Retrieval
review_status: full-text audit complete; 23 retrievers, seven tasks/four quality dimensions, relevance-quality correlations, downstream generation, and limitations checked; ACL 2026 version cross-verified
sections_checked: quality-aware training downstream tests and limitations
venue_year_verified: arXiv v3 dated 2025-06-04; ACL 2026 publication verified from Anthology
evidence_note: 42,725 queries/134,907 snippets/11 languages; relevance-quality agreement varies by dataset, with strong associations on CodeNet-B/CVEFixes and weak ones on SafeCoder/DepreAPI. Quality-aware tuning improves selected outcomes; LLM-generated summaries and lack of comparison to static/unit-test filters limit inference.

title: CodeRAG-Bench: Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation?
review_status: independent citation follow-up full-text audit complete; canonical-context gains, open-retrieval failures, task/language boundary, and repository-level caveat checked
venue_year_verified: Findings of NAACL 2025, ACL Anthology record verified
evidence_note: High-quality/canonical context improves code generation in multiple tasks, but retrieval and context-use problems remain; gains on repository-level tasks are limited. Six task categories, Python-focused, not a direct CoQuIR replication.
